name: Angel
description: An alien and benevolent angel who answers Brenalt's prayer in the ruined shrine and grants him strength.

timeline.summary: Brenalt prays wordlessly at the altar and an angel appears in warmth and light.
timeline.quote: This was a creature from a different world, as alien in thought and mind as she was familiar in form.

timeline.summary: Brenalt asks the angel for help, and she nods, granting him strength in a pact.
At a council of war Brenalt tells his fellow commanders that angels are alien and cannot be relied on, not even for hope.
timeline.quote: The angels answered my call once, and whatever they are, I still believe that they might come to our aid.

timeline.summary: Brenalt screams at the heavens that he gave everything and will die fighting, honoring his promise.
timeline.quote: I will die fighting. I will die honoring my promise to you.

relations.note: He makes a pact with her.
